title: Los Angeles
sideASummary: Player deck back. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Yellow Los Angeles Player card, 34°3'8"N 118°14'37"W. Port: the compass has an anchor. Two covered boxes, SEARCH THE LAND and SEARCH THE SEA. This is Los Angeles's only Player card. Code P1-13b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Take 4 Supply cubes from the reserve and add them to the stockpile. Resolved once, when the land box is scratched.
Open door 60 and add it to the board. If 60 is already open, gain 1 action instead.

states.summary: Land only. Old shipping containers still hold supplies. Take 4 Supply cubes from the reserve and add them to the stockpile. The sea box stays covered.
Sea only. A lost haven has been located but not accessed. Open 60 and add it to the board, or gain 1 action if 60 is already open. The land box stays covered.
Both boxes scratched. Land adds 4 Supply cubes from the reserve to the stockpile. Sea opens door 60, or grants 1 action if 60 is already open.

rules: Yellow Player card for Los Angeles. Port: the compass has an anchor.
Two scratch boxes, searched independently. State 2 is land only. State 3 is sea only. State 4 is both.
Land: take 4 Supply cubes from the reserve and add them to the stockpile.
Sea: open door 60 and add that haven to the board. If 60 is already open, gain 1 action instead.
Neither result is a companion. Each is resolved when its box is scratched.
This is Los Angeles's only Player card. It goes to the reserve until the city joins the grid.
notes: Card id 910. State card ids: state 2 is 1005, state 3 is 1004, state 4 is 1003.
Printed code P1-13b stays on every scratched face.
No state side A. San Francisco's sea box opens the same door 60.
The cubes come from the reserve, not the stockpile, and are added to the stockpile.
